name: JW Marriott Hotel Frankfurt
positioning: Wellbeing-focused city hotel in Frankfurt's financial district, with every room at least 80 meters above the street
best_for: Travelers who want high-floor skyline views in central Frankfurt
Guests who want a spa and a large gym with an indoor pool in the same building

facts.text: The hotel sits in Frankfurt's financial district with direct access to the MyZeil shopping center.
Every room and suite is at least 80 meters above ground level and has floor-to-ceiling windows.
Guestrooms and suites start at 33 square meters.
Bathrooms are designed to feel like a spa, with neutral tones and chrome fixtures.
Rooms and suites are decorated with original artworks created exclusively by Hartwig Ebersbach.
Harmony Spa is on the sixth floor and has separate male and female saunas.
Harmony Spa treatments use products by the French brand Sothys.
The hotel partners with Fitness First to give guests complimentary direct access to its training facility.
The GRETA OTO Frankfurt restaurant is reached by a sweeping staircase that rises from the GRETA OTO Bar.
JW Market sells the hotel's own honey, made by bees that live on the hotel rooftop.
Frankfurt's Museum Embankment, with over 39 cultural institutions, is a short stroll from the hotel.
Frankfurt Airport is about 20 minutes by car from the hotel.

highlights.text: Each room and suite sits at least 80 meters up behind floor-to-ceiling windows, with views of either the city or the River Main.
Premium suites are on the building's highest floors, and suite guests get chocolates on arrival and a complimentary minibar.
The Fitness First facility, reached via the sixth floor, has a 20-meter indoor pool with a relaxation area and over 60 classes every week.
The Mindful Oasis has a green wall, and relaxation nooks in the lobby offer meditative soundtracks via QR code.
An apple and lemon welcome elixir, blended with thyme from the hotel's JW Garden, is served at check-in.

considerations.text: Cash payment is not possible anywhere in the hotel; all major credit cards are accepted.
Rollaway beds are not permitted in the rooms.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing typical of luxury business hotels.
